scope: offline scanner/UI server-owned FDC reference connection audit
verified_boundaries: nutrition-fdc-preview-api rejects disabled-by-default calls before network
preview and accept requests contain server references only
scanner calls vision prediction and optional enrichment only
scanner does not import or call FDC confirmation, detail, profile-preview or profile-accept helpers
scanner does not retain scanContext in component state for a later confirmation action
backend exposes FDC confirmation/detail/preview/accept POST routes but no HTTP route currently exposes or creates a server-owned candidate snapshot for scanner UI
not_verified: confirmation envelope UI and item-by-item candidate selection
issued scan revision handoff after confirmation
mobile camera/gallery confirmation -> preview -> accept flow
any production flag or source registry admission

data_integrity_fix.issue: new enrichment item without a positive server-owned weight previously defaulted to 100g
data_integrity_fix.resolution: reject the new item from the recordable scanner list and keep existing detections unchanged
data_integrity_fix.regression: unknown and non-positive weights remain unresolved; no invented 100g

required_before_ui_connection: server-owned candidate snapshot must be created from the authenticated scan context and exposed through a bounded, user-bound reference
snapshot must include digest, scan revision, item identity and presented candidates; client must never invent candidates or FDC IDs
confirmation route response must provide an issued revision/confirmation reference that the UI can pass to profile-preview
scanner must retain the server references across the confirmation interaction without changing the displayed photo confidence
